query.description: DKAN datastore query of one data.medicaid.gov dataset: rows with optional filters (conditions[i][property|value|operator]), sorts and a column list. Pages of 5,000 rows (the API caps a page at 8,000).

dataset.desc: catalog alias (enrollment, sdud_2025, nadac_2026, ...) or data.medicaid.gov dataset id (UUID)

index.desc: distribution index inside the dataset; 0 = its first (CSV) distribution

conditions[0][property].desc: filter 0: column name (snake_case, as in the rows)

conditions[0][value].desc: filter 0: one value (matching ignores case); for IN use conditions[0][value][0..9]

conditions[0][operator].desc: filter 0: = (default), <>, <, <=, >, >=, like (with %), in, not in, between; < > compare numbers only on int/numeric columns (text columns compare as text)

conditions[1][property].desc: filter 1: column name (snake_case, as in the rows)

conditions[1][value].desc: filter 1: one value (matching ignores case); for IN use conditions[0][value][0..9]

conditions[1][operator].desc: filter 1: = (default), <>, <, <=, >, >=, like (with %), in, not in, between; < > compare numbers only on int/numeric columns (text columns compare as text)

conditions[2][property].desc: filter 2: column name (snake_case, as in the rows)

conditions[2][value].desc: filter 2: one value (matching ignores case); for IN use conditions[0][value][0..9]

conditions[2][operator].desc: filter 2: = (default), <>, <, <=, >, >=, like (with %), in, not in, between; < > compare numbers only on int/numeric columns (text columns compare as text)

conditions[3][property].desc: filter 3: column name (snake_case, as in the rows)

conditions[3][value].desc: filter 3: one value (matching ignores case); for IN use conditions[0][value][0..9]

conditions[3][operator].desc: filter 3: = (default), <>, <, <=, >, >=, like (with %), in, not in, between; < > compare numbers only on int/numeric columns (text columns compare as text)

conditions[0][value][0].desc: value 0 of an in / not in / between list on filter 0 (a comma-separated single value matches nothing)

conditions[0][value][1].desc: value 1 of an in / not in / between list on filter 0 (a comma-separated single value matches nothing)

conditions[0][value][2].desc: value 2 of an in / not in / between list on filter 0 (a comma-separated single value matches nothing)

conditions[0][value][3].desc: value 3 of an in / not in / between list on filter 0 (a comma-separated single value matches nothing)

conditions[0][value][4].desc: value 4 of an in / not in / between list on filter 0 (a comma-separated single value matches nothing)

conditions[0][value][5].desc: value 5 of an in / not in / between list on filter 0 (a comma-separated single value matches nothing)

conditions[0][value][6].desc: value 6 of an in / not in / between list on filter 0 (a comma-separated single value matches nothing)

conditions[0][value][7].desc: value 7 of an in / not in / between list on filter 0 (a comma-separated single value matches nothing)

conditions[0][value][8].desc: value 8 of an in / not in / between list on filter 0 (a comma-separated single value matches nothing)

conditions[0][value][9].desc: value 9 of an in / not in / between list on filter 0 (a comma-separated single value matches nothing)

datasets.description: The whole data.medicaid.gov catalog (about 560 datasets, 0.8 MB): identifier, title, description, modified date, theme, keywords, download URL. Search it for a dataset id the pack's catalog does not list.

dataset_info.description: Metadata of one dataset (one row): title, description, modified date, temporal coverage when given, distribution download URL and data dictionary link.

enrollment.name: State Medicaid and CHIP Applications, Eligibility Determinations, and Enrollment Data
enrollment.description: Monthly by state since 2013-09 (Performance Indicator data behind the monthly enrollment reports): total Medicaid and CHIP enrollment, Medicaid, CHIP, child and adult enrollment, applications, determinations, call centers. Two rows per state-month (preliminary P and updated U) except the latest month.

eligibility_processing.name: State Medicaid and CHIP Eligibility Processing Data
eligibility_processing.description: Monthly renewals by state since 2023-03: renewals due, renewed (ex parte or by form), disenrolled (ineligible or procedural), pending. Original (O) and updated (U) rows.

renewal_outcomes_updated.name: Medicaid and CHIP Updated Renewal Outcomes
renewal_outcomes_updated.description: Unwinding-period renewal outcomes updated after reconsideration (2023-2024; last updated 2024-11).

chip_enrollment.name: Separate CHIP Enrollment by Month and State
chip_enrollment.description: Separate CHIP (S-CHIP) enrollment by state and coverage month from T-MSIS, with the T-MSIS data-through month.

chip_enrollment_historic.name: Separate CHIP Enrollment by Month and State - Historic CAA/Unwinding Period
chip_enrollment_historic.description: Separate CHIP enrollment by state, 2023-04 to 2024 (CAA 2023 reporting), with a USA row; values are text with commas.

new_adult.name: Medicaid Enrollment - New Adult Group
new_adult.description: Monthly Medicaid enrollees and ACA expansion (VIII group) enrollees, newly and not newly eligible, by state, from the CMS-64 enrollment reports.

eligibility_group_monthly.name: Major Eligibility Group Information for Medicaid and CHIP Beneficiaries by Month
eligibility_group_monthly.description: T-MSIS (TAF) enrollees by state, month and major eligibility group (children, adult expansion, aged, disabled ...) since 2016.

managed_care_monthly.name: Managed Care Information for Medicaid and CHIP Beneficiaries by Month
managed_care_monthly.description: T-MSIS (TAF) enrollees by state, month and managed care participation.

managed_care_summary.name: Managed Care Enrollment Summary
managed_care_summary.description: Annual (as of July 1) Medicaid enrollees in any managed care and in comprehensive MCOs by state, 2016 on; includes a TOTALS row.

managed_care_share.name: Share of Medicaid Enrollees in Managed Care
managed_care_share.description: Annual share of Medicaid enrollees in any managed care and in comprehensive managed care by state.

managed_care_plans.name: Managed Care Enrollment by Program and Plan
managed_care_plans.description: Annual enrollment by state, managed care program and plan (Medicaid-only, dual, total), with parent organization.

managed_care_population.name: Managed Care Enrollment by Program and Population (All)
managed_care_population.description: Annual enrollment by state and program type (comprehensive MCO, PCCM, MLTSS, BHO, dental, transportation, PACE).

mltss.name: Managed Long Term Services and Supports (MLTSS) Enrollees
mltss.description: Annual MLTSS enrollees by state and program.

cms64_fmr.name: Medicaid Financial Management Data (CMS-64)
cms64_fmr.description: CMS-64 expenditures by state, program and service category, total computable, federal and state share. ONLY fiscal year 2016 is in the datastore; later years are files on www.medicaid.gov (manual browser download).

cms64_fmr_national.name: Medicaid Financial Management Data - National Totals
cms64_fmr_national.description: CMS-64 national totals by program and service category, fiscal year 2016 only.

cms64_new_adult.name: Medicaid CMS-64 New Adult Group Expenditures
cms64_new_adult.description: Quarterly medical assistance and expansion (VIII group) expenditures by state, total computable and federal share, since 2014Q1. Numbers are text with commas; N/A where a state had no expansion.

cms64_ffcra.name: Medicaid CMS-64 FFCRA Increased FMAP Expenditure
cms64_ffcra.description: Quarterly federal share from the FFCRA 6.2-point FMAP increase (section 6008) and the COVID-19 testing group (section 6004) by state, 2020Q2 on.

cms64_caa2023.name: Medicaid CMS-64 CAA 2023 Increased FMAP Expenditure Data Collected through MBES/CBES
cms64_caa2023.description: Quarterly federal share from the CAA 2023 phase-down of the increased FMAP (FY2023 Q3 to FY2024 Q1) by state.

eligibility_levels.name: Medicaid and CHIP Eligibility Levels
eligibility_levels.description: Income eligibility limits (% of the federal poverty level) by state and group; not updated since 2018.

nadac_2026.name: NADAC (National Average Drug Acquisition Cost) 2026
nadac_2026.description: Weekly NADAC per unit by NDC, 2026 (about 1.3 million rows: always filter by ndc or ndc_description).

nadac_2025.name: NADAC (National Average Drug Acquisition Cost) 2025
nadac_2025.description: Weekly NADAC per unit by NDC, 2025.

nadac_2024.name: NADAC (National Average Drug Acquisition Cost) 2024
nadac_2024.description: Weekly NADAC per unit by NDC, 2024.

nadac_comparison.name: NADAC Comparison
nadac_comparison.description: Week-to-week NADAC changes by NDC (old and new rate, percent change, reason), 2021 on (3.5 million rows).

nadac_first_time.name: First Time NADAC Rates
nadac_first_time.description: NDCs given a NADAC rate for the first time.

sdud_2026.name: State Drug Utilization Data 2026
sdud_2026.description: Quarterly outpatient drug prescriptions and reimbursement by state, NDC and utilization type (FFSU fee-for-service, MCOU managed care), 2026; state XX = national total. Over a million rows: always filter (state, ndc, product_name, quarter).

sdud_2025.name: State Drug Utilization Data 2025
sdud_2025.description: Quarterly outpatient drug prescriptions and reimbursement by state, NDC and utilization type (FFSU fee-for-service, MCOU managed care), 2025; state XX = national total. Over a million rows: always filter (state, ndc, product_name, quarter).

sdud_2024.name: State Drug Utilization Data 2024
sdud_2024.description: Quarterly outpatient drug prescriptions and reimbursement by state, NDC and utilization type (FFSU fee-for-service, MCOU managed care), 2024; state XX = national total. Over a million rows: always filter (state, ndc, product_name, quarter).

sdud_2023.name: State Drug Utilization Data 2023
sdud_2023.description: Quarterly outpatient drug prescriptions and reimbursement by state, NDC and utilization type (FFSU fee-for-service, MCOU managed care), 2023; state XX = national total. Over a million rows: always filter (state, ndc, product_name, quarter).

sdud_2022.name: State Drug Utilization Data 2022
sdud_2022.description: Quarterly outpatient drug prescriptions and reimbursement by state, NDC and utilization type (FFSU fee-for-service, MCOU managed care), 2022; state XX = national total. Over a million rows: always filter (state, ndc, product_name, quarter).

sdud_2021.name: State Drug Utilization Data 2021
sdud_2021.description: Quarterly outpatient drug prescriptions and reimbursement by state, NDC and utilization type (FFSU fee-for-service, MCOU managed care), 2021; state XX = national total. Over a million rows: always filter (state, ndc, product_name, quarter).

sdud_2020.name: State Drug Utilization Data 2020
sdud_2020.description: Quarterly outpatient drug prescriptions and reimbursement by state, NDC and utilization type (FFSU fee-for-service, MCOU managed care), 2020; state XX = national total. Over a million rows: always filter (state, ndc, product_name, quarter).
